purpose: Connect related Almora needs so one request can surface the next useful service instead of ending in a silo.

links.rule: A job match should also check commute feasibility, required skills and employer verification.
Health navigation may suggest transport and nearby verified facilities but must not diagnose.
A road disruption can affect buses, emergency access, schools, visitors and deliveries.
Wildlife reports can inform crop risk and public-safety routing without recommending harm.
Farm support should connect risk, market access, transport and applicable public support.
Verified local businesses can hire, receive service demand and appear in relevant discovery.
Trips should combine current conditions, access, culture and local commerce.
Education guidance should connect students to access, funding and future local work.
Price anomalies and scam reports remain evidence-first and go to human review before publication.
Cultural discovery should support attribution, local artists, learning and responsible tourism.
